# Innovatio Brutalis

> A Malmö-based development partner in Sweden, from ideas and system architecture to working physical and connected prototypes.

## Core services
- Product development and industrial design
- Prototyping, rapid prototyping and functional prototypes
- Mechatronics and embedded prototyping with ESP32/Arduino
- MicroPython firmware on ESP32, sensors, actuators and valve control
- E-ink displays, RFID/NFC, BLE, Wi-Fi and mobile app communication
- Engineering, CAD and simulation
- Reverse engineering and 3D scanning
- 3D printing and CNC machining
- CO₂ laser cutting and laser engraving in laser-suitable materials
- Acrylic cutting and transparent acrylic processing
- Prototype panels, fixtures and low-volume laser production
- Low-volume production

## Primary service area
Malmö, Skåne, southern Sweden and Sweden.

## Laser capability and process selection
The right manufacturing method for each part of the prototype: CAD, mechatronics, 3D printing, CO₂ laser cutting, CNC and reverse engineering can be combined.
Bambu Lab R1, 55 W CO₂, normal work area 600 × 300 mm. Installed Auto-feed Conveyor supports material up to 3 000 mm long through incremental feeding; the active width remains 600 mm. Riser Base is installed.
Materials, thickness and edge quality are assessed per application; manufacturer demonstrations are not guaranteed production specifications. PVC/Vinyl is for 3D printing, never laser cutting or engraving.
Multi-process examples are illustrative, not claims of new delivered projects or laser components in the documented valve-control example.

## Project example
ESP32/Arduino-based valve-control units with MicroPython firmware on ESP32, e-ink, RFID and wireless communication with an iOS application.
BLE or Wi-Fi is selected according to the application's requirements. No component models, test measurements or certifications are claimed without project documentation.
